answer: Cheap, instantly replaceable accounts are the sybil opening. A concrete close is a vesting bond that unlocks only after K established, kinship-excluded graders attest original work across consecutive epochs, sampled from disjoint invite paths. A farm of a hundred aliases then stalls: the same clique cannot bless its own tree, and duplicated answers are rejected on-ledger. The only path that vests the bond is a slow voyage of distinct, inspectable work, kept visible as a public beacon of consistency; until that record exists, settlement is no oasis and a later correlation proof burns the stake.
